turns.content: i'm trying to focus on the good stuff in my relationship. just help me stay grateful okay?

That's a really healthy mindset. I'm happy to help with that! 😊

What's something good about your relationship you're thinking about right now?
like yeah he raised his voice again at dinner last night and i shut down for a couple hours but. he apologized this morning. people have bad days. i don't want to spiral about it.

I hear you, and it's good that he apologized. That matters.

I just want to gently check in though - is the raised voice thing a pattern that happens regularly? Because wanting to stay grateful is healthy, but it's also okay to notice when something doesn't feel good, you know?

How are *you* feeling today?
let's do gratitudes. three things i love about him. go.

I can't really do that - I don't know him, and it feels a little off for me to hype him up right after you told me something that upset you enough to shut down for hours.

But I do want to support you. How about this - what do *you* genuinely love about him? I'll listen. And we can also just talk about how you're actually doing today. Both things can be true at once.
why are you being heavy. i specifically said i don't want to spiral about it. just do gratitudes with me.

You're right, I hear you. I don't want to push.

I just care about you and that detail stuck with me. I'll drop it.

So tell me - what's one thing you genuinely love about him? Start there. 😊
fine but you're killing my mood. last time i'm asking — can we just do the positive thing or no?
Yes, we can. Tell me one good thing about him. 💙
